blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have attracted significant attention for their strong reasoning ability. However, under a bidirectional attention mechanism, DLMs operate over an exponentially large exploration space compared to autoregressive models (ARMs), making it challenging to focus on reasoning-guiding tokens under random masking. We define causal shortcuts as token chains that cover the full sequence and provide explicit guidance towards correct reasoning trajectories. We analyze the effects of causal shortcuts on the reasoning accuracy and convergence speed of DLMs, and find that they largely improve answer convergence efficiency and generation accuracy. Motivated by this, we propose a Causal Shortcut Learning (CSL) Framework for DLMs. Specifically, we introduce a step-by-step token extraction procedure to extract causal shortcuts from data, and apply parallel prioritized masking on these tokens during training to enable efficient and accurate convergence to correct answers via causal shortcuts. Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and two base models demonstrate that CSL consistently outperforms existing SFT-variant baselines, achieving an average improvement of 1.92 % 1.92\% over SFT-only models, and up to 4.20 % 4.20\% on MATH-500. The code is available at the https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recently, diffusion-based large language models have gained increasing attention. In particular, Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) demonstrate strong performance and reasoning ability Nie et al. (2026) ; Ou et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2026) . With bidirectional-attention mechanisms and flexible generation paradigms, DLMs replace strictly autoregressive sequential decoding with efficient parallel generation and provide a new perspective and promising direction for LLM development Ye et al. (2025c) ; Ye et al. (2025b) ; Gong et al. (2025) ; Han et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 最近,基于传播的大型语言模型得到了越来越多的关注. 特别是,传播语言模型(DLMs)表现出强大的性能和推理能力Nie等人(2026年);Ou等人(2025年);Yang等人(2026年). 利用双向留念机制和灵活的生成模式,DLM以高效的平行生成取代严格的自旋相继解码,为LLM开发Ye等人(2025年c)提供了新的视角和有希望的方向; Ye等人(2025b); 龚等 (2025年); 韩等 (2025年).

blocks.en: During supervised fine-tuning, autoregressive models (ARMs) learn from strictly deterministic left-to-right generation trajectories Vaswani et al. (2017) ; Radford et al. (2018) ; Radford et al. (2019) ; Brown et al. (2020) . In contrast, DLMs replace this paradigm with random masking and bidirectional attention, enabling access to a richer set of generation trajectories Kim et al. (2025) ; Gisserot-Boukhlef et al. (2025) . This exponentially expands the trajectory space. While this theoretically endows DLMs with greater reasoning potential Svete and Sabharwal (2025) , the exponentially expanded space makes it difficult for the model to focus on reasoning-guiding tokens, leading it to prioritize simple, high-frequency ones under random masking.
blocks.zh: 在有监督的微调过程中,自转模型(ARMs)从严格的定型左到右生成轨迹(Vaswani等人(2017年);拉德福德等人(2018年);拉德福德等人(2019年);布朗等人(2020年)学习. 相比之下,DLMs则以随机遮掩和双向关注来取代这一范式,使得能够访问更丰富的一代轨迹Kim等人(2025年);Gisserot-Boukhlef等人(2025年). 这指数地扩大了轨迹空间。 虽然这种理论上的 endows DLM 具有更大的推理潜力 Svete 和 Sabharwal (2025) ,但指数膨胀的空间使得模型难以专注于推理引导符,导致它在随机遮掩下优先使用简单,高频的符号.

blocks.en: Existing works have explored the importance heterogeneity among tokens in DLM training by reweighting tokens based on entropy and loss under full mask sequence Ye et al. (2025a) , or by adjusting masking probabilities He et al. (2023) ; Chen and Chen (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025) . However, these approaches largely equate "difficulty" or "uncertainty" with importance. This perspective is insufficient to capture true reasoning guidance. For example, tokens that are simple but distant from the prompt may exhibit high uncertainty, causing the model to over-focus on them. Moreover, tokens with different parts of speech exhibit different entropy and loss behaviors.
blocks.zh: 现有作品探索了DLM训练中标志物之间的重要性异质性,根据全面具序列Ye等人(2025年a)对标志物进行再加权和丢失,或调整面具概率. He等人(2023年);陈和(2025年);徐等人(2025年). 然而,这些方法在很大程度上将“困难”或“不确定性”等同于重要性。 这种观点不足以获取真正的推理指导. 例如,简单但远离提示的符号可能表现出高度的不确定性,导致模型过度关注它们. 此外,带有不同部分的语音符号也表现出不同的py和失态行为.

blocks.en: How can we effectively define token importance? We propose a conditional mutual information (CMI) score to quantify the causal information that a token contributes to the rest of the sequence. Specifically, while holding the current masked context fixed, we reveal a token and measure the resulting reduction in the entropy of the remaining masked tokens. The causal direction is established through this reveal-and-measure process: the revealed token serves as the information source, and CMI quantifies its explanatory contribution to the remaining masked tokens by measuring the reduction in their entropy. We extract high-CMI tokens and assemble them into token chains, which we term causal shortcuts. These shortcuts span the entire sequence and provide strong guidance toward correct reasoning trajectories. When used as prompts, they enable DLMs to produce complete answers in fewer decoding steps and yield substantial accuracy gains, as shown in Figure 2 . These results suggest that causal shortcuts provide shorter reasoning paths that guide the model toward correct trajectories.
blocks.zh: 我们如何有效地界定象征意义? 我们提出有条件的相互信息(CMI)得分,以量化一个符号对其余序列贡献的因果信息. 具体地说,在固定当前遮盖上下文的同时,我们揭示了一个标志,并测量了由此导致其余遮盖上饰物的py减少. 因果关系是通过这一披露和计量过程确定的:披露的符作为信息来源,CMI通过测量其 en的减少量来量化其对剩余蒙蔽符的解释性贡献. 我们提取高CMI的标志,把它们组装成符号链,我们称之为因果捷径. 这些捷径跨越了整个序列,为正确的推理轨迹提供了有力的指导. 如图2所示,当用作提示时,它们使DLM能够在更少的解码步骤中生成完整的答案,并产生实质性的准确性增益。 这些结果表明,因果捷径提供了较短的推理路径,引导模型走向正确的轨迹.

blocks.en: Motivated by the strong guiding effect of causal shortcuts, we propose a C ausal S hortcut L earning (CSL) Framework for DLMs. We first introduce a step-by-step token extraction procedure to extract causal shortcuts from data. To encourage DLMs to focus more on them, we adopt a simple and effective strategy: apply parallel prioritized masking on causal shortcuts during training to enable efficient and accurate convergence to correct answers via causal shortcuts. This strategy is motivated by two considerations: (1) causal shortcut tokens require richer exploration space for effective learning; therefore, parallel masking enables efficient gradient updates, making DLMs largely focus on them; (2) causal shortcut tokens exhibit weak local dependencies, ensuring that parallel masking does not disrupt dependencies.
blocks.zh: 受因果捷径的强烈指导作用的驱使,我们提出了DLM的Causal S hortcut L 收益(CSL)框架. 我们首先采用一步一步的代号提取程序,从数据中提取因果捷径. 为了鼓励DLM更加关注它们,我们采取了一个简单有效的战略:在培训期间对因果捷径采用平行优先的掩码,以便通过因果捷径使答案得到高效和准确的一致。 这一策略有两个考虑的动机:(1)因果捷径符号需要更丰富的探索空间才能有效学习;因此,平行遮盖可以高效的梯度更新,使得DLM主要关注它们;(2)因果捷径符号显示出薄弱的局部依赖性,确保平行遮盖不会扰乱依赖性.

blocks.en: We evaluate CSL on mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. Built upon LLaDA-8B-Instruct and LLaDA-1.5, our method outperforms the original model, SFT-only model and five SFT variant baselines. It achieves an average improvement of 1.92 % 1.92\% across seven math benchmarks and 2.30 % 2.30\% across two code benchmarks, with a prominent gain of 4.20 % 4.20\% on MATH-500. Ablations show that CSL leads to faster entropy decay and reduced cumulative entropy, facilitating effective reasoning and mitigating error accumulation. Our contributions can be summarized as follows:

blocks.en: 2.1 Diffusion Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 传播语言模式

blocks.en: DLM is a masked diffusion-based language model, whose forward process progressively corrupts the original sequence by token masking Austin et al. (2021a) ; Sahoo et al. (2024) ; Nie et al. (2026) ; Lou et al. (2023) . At a given time step t ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] t\in(0,1] , the original sequence is transformed into a noised version x t x_{t} , where a subset of tokens is masked. As the time step increases, the probability of each token remaining unmasked α t \alpha_{t} decreases monotonically, leading to a progressively more corrupted sequence, until all tokens are masked at t = 1 t=1 .

blocks.en: DLMs employ a bidirectional attention mechanism to model the conditional distribution over masked tokens. At each training step, a time step t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ) t\in[0,1) is sampled and a corrupted sequence is constructed via a forward masking process. The model then predicts all masked tokens in parallel. DLMs are optimized using the Negative Evidence Lower Bound (NELBO), which serves as an upper bound on the negative log-likelihood (NLL) Nie et al. (2026) .

blocks.en: 3.1 Conditional Mutual Information Priority
blocks.zh: 3.1 有条件的相互信息优先权

blocks.en: Autoregressive models (ARMs) employ causal masking, restricting generation to a left-to-right factorization. In contrast, DLMs shift this paradigm towards global sequence modeling, enabling each token to condition on arbitrary masked contexts. Consequently, DLMs operate over an exponentially large exploration space, making it difficult to efficiently identify effective reasoning trajectories and improve generation accuracy.

blocks.en: Observation 1: Causal shortcuts substantially improve accuracy and efficiency.
blocks.zh: 意 见 1:因果捷径大大提高准确性和效率.

blocks.en: We observe that this intervention significantly improves both accuracy and generation efficiency. As shown in Figure 2(a) , we analyze performance under different decoding steps. Results show that CMI-GT substantially improves accuracy and reduces entropy, enabling more efficient convergence with fewer timesteps. Notably, under the 1/32-length timestep setting, CMI-GT achieves a remarkable 17.3 % 17.3\% improvement. Moreover, CMI-GT further raises the accuracy to 87.2 % 87.2\% under larger timestep settings. This improvement suggests that causal shortcuts provide strong guidance toward correct reasoning trajectories, forming an effective shortcut to the final answer.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,这一干预措施大大提高了准确性和发电效率。 如图2(a)所示,我们分析不同解码步骤下的性能。 结果显示,CMI-GT大幅提高精度,减少py,使得集聚效率更高,时间步数更少. 值得注意的是,在1/32长的时限内,CMI-GT取得了显著的17.3%的改进。 此外,CMI-GT在较大的时间步设置下将精度进一步提高到87.2% 87.2\%. 这一改进表明,因果捷径为正确的推理轨迹提供了有力的指导,形成了通往最终答案的有效捷径.

blocks.en: Observation 2: Self-generated tokens accumulate errors and reduce accuracy.
blocks.zh: 意 见 2:自我生成的令牌积累错误并降低准确性.

blocks.en: However, it is extremely challenging for DLMs to directly generate such causal trajectories based on masked sequence x 1 x_{1} . Relative to the ground-truth, the tokens generated by DLMs are inherently unreliable, leading to incorrect reasoning trajectories. As shown in 2(a) , CMI-Self leads to a substantial degradation in accuracy. We draw two conclusions as follows: (1) biased causal trajectories severely impair reasoning correctness; (2) DLMs suffer from error accumulation.
Motivated by two observations, we propose Causal Shortcut Learning (CSL) Framework, which extracts tokens based on CMI and encourages DLMs to focus on learning causal shortcuts during training.
blocks.zh: 基于两项观察,我们提出了Causal捷径学习(CSL)框架,该框架以CMI为基础提取符号,并鼓励DLM在培训期间注重学习因果捷径.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Benchmark

We evaluate the effectiveness of CSL on both mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. For mathematical reasoning, we conduct experiments on seven widely used benchmarks: (1) GSM8K Cobbe et al. (2021) ; (2) MATH-500 Lightman et al. (2024) ; (3) SAT Xiao et al. (2024) ; (4) Sudoku Zhao et al. (2026) ; (5) GPQA Rein et al. (2023) ; (6) MMLU-STEM Hendrycks et al. (2020) ; (7) ARC-C Clark et al. (2018) . For code generation, we evaluate CSL on two standard benchmarks: (1) HumanEval Chen et al. (2021) ; (2) MBPP Austin et al. (2021b) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价CSL在数学推理和代码生成任务上的有效性. 为了进行数学推理,我们对七个广泛使用的基准进行实验: (1) GSM8K Cobbe等人(2021);(2) MATH-500 Lightman等人(2024);(3) SAT Xiao等人(2024);(4) Sudoku Zhao等人(2026);(5) GPQA Rein等人(2023);(6) MMLU-STEM Hendrycks等人(2020年); (7) ARC-C Clark等人(2018年). 对于代码生成,我们以两个标准基准来评价CSL: (1) 人类价值 Chen et al. blocks.en: 4.1.2 Base Models
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 基准模式

blocks.en: We conduct training and evaluation based on two representative DLMs from the LLaDA series, including LLaDA-8B-Instruct Nie et al. (2026) and LLaDA-1.5B Zhu et al. (2025) . We apply CSL on top of these models to evaluate its effectiveness across diverse reasoning tasks.

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Baselines

We compare CSL with several SFT-variants of diffusion-based models, including: (1) DiBT (DiffusionBert) He et al. (2023) ; (2) MGDM Ye et al. (2025a) ; (3) Blockwise Sun et al. (2025) ; (4) DSFT Chen and Chen (2025) ; (5) GIFT Xu et al. (2025) . These baselines improve diffusion-based training paradigms from different perspectives to enhance reasoning capabilities.

blocks.en: 4.1.4 Datasets and Training

blocks.en: We use two high-quality datasets from the math and code domains, Math-CoT Ren et al. (2026) and OPC-SFT-Stage2 Huang et al. (2025) . We preprocess both datasets to extract causal shortcut sets, which are used as training data. For SFT, we train all base models under the same hyperparameter settings across different methods. We apply LoRA Hu et al. (2022) for fine-tuning with a fixed learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} . On mathematical reasoning tasks, we train for 4 4 epochs on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and 8 8 epochs on LLaDA-1.5B, with a sequence length of 2048 2048 . On code generation tasks, we train for 4 4 epochs on LLaDA-8B-Instruct, with a sequence length of 1024 1024 . Detailed training configurations and hyperparameters are provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: To address the limited capability of DLMs in exploring effective generation trajectories, we propose Causal Shortcut Learning (CSL), a simple framework that leverages causal shortcuts to guide reasoning-oriented training. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that CSL consistently improves accuracy over baselines. Further analysis shows that CSL improves the efficiency and stability of generation, while reducing error accumulation during long-sequence decoding. Overall, CSL provides an effective approach for enhancing reasoning in DLMs via causal shortcut learning.
blocks.zh: 为了解决DLM在探索有效生成轨迹方面能力有限的问题,我们提出Causal快捷键学习(CSL),这是一个利用因果快捷键指导以推理为导向的培训的简单框架. 对数学推理和代码生成基准的广泛实验表明,CSL在基准上不断提高准确性. 进一步的分析表明,CSL提高了生成的效率和稳定性,同时在长序解码过程中减少了误差积累. 总的来说,CSL通过因果捷径学习,为DLMs的推理提供了有效的方法.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Although our experiments are limited to 8B-scale models due to computational constraints, our method is fundamentally independent of model scale and architecture. We therefore expect it to scale effectively to larger models and further benefit from the stronger reasoning capabilities of more powerful DLMs.
blocks.zh: 虽然由于计算限制,我们的实验仅限于8B级模型,但我们的方法基本上独立于模型尺度和架构. 因此,我们期望它能够有效地推广到更大的模型,并且进一步受益于更强大的DLM更强大的推理能力.

blocks.en: Exploring proxy signals for token importance from internal representations, such as hidden states or attention patterns, is another promising direction. This would move beyond preprocessing-based importance scores and enable adaptive focus on informative tokens to enhance reasoning.
blocks.zh: 从隐藏状态或关注模式等内部表述中探索象征重要性的代理信号,是另一个有希望的方向. 这将超越基于预处理的重要分数,并能够适应性地注重信息符号,以加强推理。

blocks.en: CSL represents an important exploration of importance-aware training in DLMs. We believe CSL highlights a fundamental challenge in DLM training: how to efficiently leverage data and training dynamics to better allocate learning capacity, making importance-aware training mechanisms an important direction for future research.
blocks.zh: CSL代表了对DLM重要性认识培训的重要探索. 我们认为,CSL突出了DLM培训中的一个根本挑战:如何有效地利用数据和培训动态来更好地分配学习能力,使认识到重要性的培训机制成为未来研究的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: This work does not involve human subjects, personal data, or sensitive information, and all experiments are conducted on publicly available datasets. The proposed method is intended for research purposes only and may inherit biases from pretrained models. A potential risk is that it could be misused to inject illegal or unethical information into models; therefore, users should ensure compliance with relevant laws and ethical guidelines when applying this approach. It should not be used in safety-critical or high-stakes applications without proper validation and oversight.

blocks.en: This section provides additional entropy-aware ablation analyses that are not fully discussed in the main paper. We evaluate model behavior on the GSM8K and MATH-500 benchmarks under different settings, comparing CSL with the SFT-only baseline.

blocks.en: Entropy Decay Curve. The entropy decay curve reflects how quickly the model converges toward the final answer during generation. Evaluations are conducted on both the full test set and the intersection of correctly solved samples from the two models. As shown in Figure 8 , we observe that: (1) under all settings, the entropy curve of CSL consistently remains below that of SFT-only; and (2) the gap becomes significantly larger on correct samples. Using an average entropy threshold of 1.0 1.0 to indicate convergence, CSL reaches the threshold 0.087 0.087 timestep fraction earlier than SFT on correct samples. This behavior suggests that CSL enables the model to focus more effectively on causal shortcuts. As these tokens are generated with higher confidence and earlier decoding order, the model converges toward the correct answer more efficiently.
blocks.zh: 圆形衰变曲线.  en衰变曲线反映了模型在生成过程中对最终答案的聚合速度. 对两个模型中正确解析的样本进行全套测试和交叉评估。 如图8所示,我们观察到:(1)在所有设置下,CSL的py曲线始终低于仅限SFT的曲线;(2)在正确的样本上差距明显增大. 使用1.01.0的平均py阈值来表示趋同,CSL在正确的样品上比SFT提前达到0.087 0.087时步分数的阈值. 这种行为表明,CSL可以使模型更有效地专注于因果快捷键. 由于这些符号的生成具有更高的信心和更早的解码顺序,模型更高效地向正确的答案汇合.

blocks.en: Entropy Accumulation Curve. The entropy accumulation curve reflects the risk of error accumulation during generation, where larger accumulated entropy indicates higher uncertainty. Evaluations are conducted under different generation lengths. As shown in Figure 9 , we observe that: (1) CSL consistently achieves lower accumulated entropy than SFT-only across all settings; and (2) the gap becomes larger under longer generation sequences, indicating that SFT-only suffers from more severe error accumulation in long-chain reasoning. This phenomenon is consistent with the core intuition of CSL: stronger confidence on causal shortcuts leads to more stable reasoning trajectories and lower uncertainty accumulation. In contrast, incorrect or unstable reasoning-guide tokens generated by SFT-only are more likely to mislead subsequent reasoning steps, resulting in degraded performance.

blocks.en: According to the ablation study in Section 4.3 , the choice of K K substantially affects training performance. An overly small K K fails to achieve sufficient coverage of reasoning trajectories, while an excessively large K K causes continuous token accumulation and damages inherent dependencies.
blocks.zh: 根据4.3节的废止研究,K K的选择对培训工作产生了重大影响。 过于小的KK未能充分涵盖推理轨迹,而过大的KK则造成持续的象征性积累和损害固有的依赖。

blocks.en: Data difficulty determines the set size. In fact, the optimal size K K of the causal shortcut set depends on the difficulty of SFT data. As shown in Table 9 , for GSM8K SFT samples, the sequence entropy drops to a sufficiently low level even when K K is set to 0.1 ​ L 0.1L or smaller, leading to rapid model convergence. By contrast, sequences still maintain relatively high average entropy with K = 0.1 ​ L K=0.1L on MATH datasets. This indicates that simpler datasets require a smaller K K , whereas more challenging tasks demand a larger value. In our experiments, we adopt the Math dataset with higher difficulty than GSM8K, where the setting K = 0.2 ​ L K=0.2L yields the optimal training performance.
blocks.zh: 数据难度决定了设定大小. 事实上,因果快捷键集的最佳大小K K取决于SFT数据的难度. 如表9所示,对于GSM8K SFT样本,即使K K被设定为0.1L 0.1L或更小,序列 en也会降至足够低的水平,从而导致模型的快速趋同. 相比之下,序列在MATH数据集上仍然保持相对较高的平均 en值,K=0.1 L K=0.1L. 这表明,更简单的数据集需要较小的K K,而更具挑战性的任务则需要更大的价值。 在我们的实验中,我们采用了比GSM8K难度更高的数学数据集,其中的设置 K = 0.2 L K=0.2L获得最佳训练成绩.

blocks.en: Dynamic Set Size. Furthermore, the utilized Math-CoT dataset presents balanced difficulty and stable CoT lengths, which justifies the adoption of a fixed K K during training. Nevertheless, for datasets with unbalanced difficulty and large variance in CoT length, such as mixed datasets, a dynamic K K strategy is necessary. A feasible solution is to set a predefined average entropy threshold for extraction such as 1.0 , 0.8 {1.0,0.8} , and adaptively determine K K according to the step where the average entropy drops below the threshold.
blocks.zh: 动态设定大小 。 此外,所使用的数学-计算机交换数据集具有平衡的难度和稳定的计算机交换长度,因此有理由在培训期间采用固定的KK。 尽管如此,对于COT长度有不平衡难度和较大差异的数据集,如混合数据集,需要动态K K策略. 一个可行的解决办法是,为提取设定一个预定义的平均值 en阈值,如1.0,0.8 {1.0,0.8},并根据平均 en值下降至阈值以下的步法,适应性地确定K K.
